title: A Tsetlin Machine Image Classification Accelerator on a Flexible Substrate
new_feature: First digital TM inference engines on a flexible integrated circuit (Pragmatic 600 nm IGZO thin-film FlexIC): hard-wired 4-stage pipelined TM (clause logic, adder tree, argmax) for 8x8 handwritten digits, in a full-scale and a compact variant, with model selection over 500 random seeds to trade accuracy against gate count.

datasets.name_in_paper: handwritten digit recognition dataset of 8x8-pixel images (cited as UCI, doi 10.24432/C50P49); also loosely called MNIST in the text
datasets.split_as_reported: not stated; accuracies reported as validation accuracy
datasets.notes: DOI 10.24432/C50P49 is the UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits dataset.

results.notes: Best of 500 models; mean across 500 seeds 98%. Paper calls it validation accuracy.
